description: Use this when the person wants b. to visit a listed home in Palo Alto, Mountain View, Cupertino, San Jose and San Mateo that b. has not toured, usually after a listing check finds no tour. Records the listing (a link or a street address), an optional note on what to check and an optional date. It stores no name, email or phone number, needs no account, and does not schedule or promise a visit; b. uses the requests to choose which homes its scouts visit next.

listing.description: The listing as you have it: a Zillow, Redfin, Apartments.com, Trulia or HotPads link, a property website link, or a street address with the unit if known, for example "360 Forest Ave #605, Palo Alto, CA".

needed_by.description: Optional: the date the person needs to decide by, YYYY-MM-DD.

what_to_check.description: Optional: what the person most wants b. to look at, for example "noise from the street at night" or "whether the second bedroom fits a queen bed". No names, emails or phone numbers.

name: request_tour
title: Ask b. to tour a listed home
